initial_target: Stage 4 pair plus phase finish plus sp_stage_c128, if the final combined profile confirms material time in that region.
reason: Stride2 matches existing Q64/128/256 high-rate tiles. Both projection dimensions fit the shared small-K matrix family. Stage3 uses stride5 and M1280/K512 and needs a different matrix policy.
state: One C*stride previous-projection column, then transformed Snake histories of 6/18/54 high-rate frames per channel. All state remains local to a call/worker.
segment_start: Warm from floor(max(0,first_output-78)/stride)*stride. Initialize the previous projection from the real preceding low-rate column if that aligned warm start is nonzero; use explicit positive zero only at global start. Discard warmup output, including extra alignment frames.
tile_schedule: For stride2, Qoutput128 means Qinput64. Reuse the current four C*Q stage scratch tiles as phase output, current projection, previous projection and gathered X; the last has K*(Q/2)=C*Q elements. After interleave, preserve only the last previous column and reuse the same scratch for the three residual units.
phased_validation: First retain an optional debug phase output and compare both complete-K projections and ordered phase output against the current graph.
Then compare all three residual outputs, segmented/whole execution, global zero, tails, tiny inputs and causal prefixes.
Only after the strict full waveform gate passes, compare whole-decoder CPU RTF and peak memory using the unchanged benchmark harness.
limits: The final profile may rank Stage3 or other work ahead of Stage4. These arithmetic/byte counts are not timing predictions.
Current matrix epilogue always adds bias, so raw projections need an explicit no-epilogue path; substituting bias0 is not an exact operation-order claim.
Keep large-K MKL/XSMM policies and single ORT thread ownership; do not nest a second matrix thread pool under segment workers.
Small projection tiles may reduce GEMM efficiency, reload weights, or exceed private cache together with hot weights. Actual data and code residency require measurement.
The two complete-K projection reductions must remain distinct. A combined 2K reduction, reassociated overlap sum, approximate Snake or fictitious biased negative-time samples is not this proposal.
